description.value: River Cafe is the breakfast and lunch spot within the historic Riverside Inn, a recently renovated hotel-restaurant-liquor store complex perched along the Cowichan River in Lake Cowichan. The menu runs from full breakfasts and eggs bennys to waffles and daily dessert pies, with two river-facing patios and a bar area featuring keno and pool tables. It sits within a self-contained complex that also houses BC's Best Buy Liquor Store — a handy one-stop for touring cyclists resupplying on the Cowichan Valley trail corridor.

address.value: 56 North Shore Road, Lake Cowichan, BC V0R 2G0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms River Cafe is an active breakfast-and-lunch cafe (8am–2pm) attached to the Riverside Inn on the Cowichan River, serving full breakfasts, brunch items, and daily desserts. A notable address discrepancy exists: OSM records '56 South Shore Road' but the website consistently states '56 North Shore Road, Lake Cowichan' across all subpages; the website value is used per schema rules. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; hotel Wi-Fi is listed for room guests but not explicitly extended to cafe patrons.
